role: Independent event-funding and prefix-cost source review
approval_scope: The exact reviewed C068 source record, explicit eager-schedule rejection and unadopted proposal boundaries only
methods: Read-only inspection of the ten named record files and relevant baseline source definitions
Independent algebraic verification of the j-dependent eager-check deficit
Review of executed-derivation receipts without rerunning the derivation
SHA-256 hashing of the exact reviewed record bytes

findings.statement: For the specified distinct per-occurrence eager schedule starting at an eligible native seam j<133, added leaf checks are 6*(134-j)-3 while removable completed numerical charges are at most 6*(133-j); the deficit is at least three before every other added cost. The pre-current-type schedule has deficit at least six.

The record correctly conditions this result on completed matched-native work and this exact schedule. It does not claim a universal admission lower bound, instrumented request opportunity or runtime result. Existing source type checks can provide only the current triple's optimistic credit; conversion equality does not establish stored-leaf exact type.

The event map retains entry, producer, interval, cold admission, seed, pending scan, retirement and fallback/repeated work. Rejected and interrupted work is not refunded; partial folds use actual reached events; native counter refusal ordering is distinguished; warm hits and multiple cold invocations retain actual incidence.

The final text makes all cost categories disjoint: repeated optional events remain in their original A/S/I categories, and F contains additional restoration/replay/ordinary work not already counted. A B-unit lookup and its included identity/presence test are not separately billed as R or T. Each concrete event is counted once.

The proposal identifies a required independent authority root before its first optional inspection or charge. It explicitly leaves the paid router, receipt layout, mutation lifetime and complete cost unresolved. Proposed B/R/T/I/N/C/W granularity is not presented as already adopted, and unknown nonnegative event sums are not assigned zero.

Static derivation code reads and hashes source, parses ASTs and enumerates integer cost formulas without importing product code. The inspected successful command receipts identify the current derivation script and derived output hashes and claim 18 bindings and 133 seams. This reviewer did not rerun those commands.

resolved_review_issue.description: Potential overlap in prose between repeated optional A/S/I events and F, plus omitted explicit exclusion of the B-unit test from T
resolved_review_issue.resolution: Root clarified CHECKPOINT-068.md, PROPOSAL-068.md and funding.json before the final byte binding

caveats: Native row, stored-list, dispatch, namespace and work authority remain unproved for a usable cheaper schedule.
A producer receipt or different explicitly versioned unit is a separate proposal with complete provenance, lifetime and funding obligations.
The cost theorem supplies no interrupted-path or foreign-first-exception equivalence theorem.
Approval does not establish actual original-request savings, latency, runtime acceptance, C057 resolution or a completed product gate.
Candidate, merge and final documentation-check outcomes remain the root integrator's separately identified evidence.
